description: Fetches and downloads U.S. budget historical tables (Excel/.xlsx) from White House OMB, including metadata, search, and section-based browsing.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - list_tables         List all available historical tables with full metadata
  - get_table_info      Get detailed info for a specific table (requires table_number)
  - download_table      Download Excel file for a table (requires table_number; optional return_content)
  - search_tables       Search tables by keyword in description (requires query)
  - get_tables_by_section  Get all tables in a section (requires section)
  - get_sections        Get all section categories with topics and table counts
  - get_intro_pdf       Get introduction PDF metadata (optional return_content)

table_number.description: Table number to fetch or download (e.g., "1.1", "7.1", "10.1"). Used by get_table_info and download_table.

query.description: Search query string for finding tables by keyword (e.g., "debt", "receipts", "agency"). Used by search_tables.

section.description: Section number to filter tables (e.g., "01", "1", "07"). Used by get_tables_by_section.

return_content.description: If true, return base64-encoded file content in the response. Used by download_table and get_intro_pdf.
